# pve_group (Resource)

Access control group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_group" "example" {
  groupid = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `groupid` (String) <string>

### Optional

- `comment` (String) <string>

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: groupid (also the `terraform import` format).
- `members` (List of String)
